class.name: velocity_to_position_command_controller/VelocityToPositionCommandController
class.description: The velocity to position command controller provides a velocity input and converts it to position commands.

class.name: self_collision_avoidance_controller/SelfCollisionAvoidanceController
class.description: A chainable controller that only forwards joint commands if the resulting configuration is collision free.

class.name: safety_forward_controller/SafetyForwardController
class.description: A high-level forward controller ensuring that all command interfaces are stopped after receiving now commands for a specified time, i.e. disconnect to operator station.

class.name: safety_position_controller/SafetyPositionController
class.description: A chainable position controller ensuring that revolute joints are unwrapped and joint limits are satisfied.

class.name: max_effort_gripper_action_controller/MaxEffortGripperActionController
class.description: Gripper action controller that simultaneously commands position and a max-effort (current/torque limit) on a single joint. Implements control_msgs/action/GripperCommand and additionally accepts position and velocity goals via topics. Publishes is_grasped (std_msgs/Bool) at action_monitor_rate. Designed for Dynamixel actuators in current-based position control mode.
